sections.title: The letter name
paragraphs: The letter is called (quê) /ke/. Its main sound is heard in the word (quatro) /ˈkwa.tɾu/, which means four. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: Mouth and voice
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air completely. Burst the air out without your voice. Then quickly round your lips to glide into the vowel. For the second sound, release the air without rounding your lips. Put a hand on your throat to feel that it does not shake.

sections.title: Reading the variants
paragraphs: Before a or o, you hear the sound in (quase) /ˈkwa.zɨ/. Before e or i, the sound is heard in (que) /kɨ/ and also in (aqui) /ɐˈki/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not add a puff of air. Keep the stop clean, like the c in scan rather than can.
